rows.title: Hook 09
rows.finding: Assigned actions are substantively correct, but omit the almost one-second initial still reaction and measured glasses/mouth transition and ending hold.

OPENING STATE: The tight front-facing close-up shows translucent eyeglasses on the face, raised brows, an open mouth and hands initially below the face.

OPENING: Bring the hand from screen-right to the outer eyeglass corner, briefly close the eyes and lift the frame past the eyes.

MIDDLE: Slide the glasses over the forehead onto the top of the head and reopen the eyes toward the lens while gradually closing the mouth.

ENDING: Release the frame and bring the same hand down until the painted fingertips rest vertically across the lips. Hold the covered-mouth look with lifted brows.

CAMERA: Keep the close handheld viewpoint with only a gentle natural bob.

ENDING STATE: The eyeglasses remain on the head and the fingertips cover the lips.

CONSTRAINT: Keep the glasses on the head after lifting them.

CONSTRAINT: Keep the rings and fingers continuous as the hand moves from frame to mouth.
